optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Data Scientist, Credit Decisioning Models

professionalSummary.text: Senior Data Scientist with four years of experience in the credit decisioning team of a consumer lender, serving as model owner of record for two application scorecards that passed independent validation in 2023 and 2025.
professionalSummary.witness: Senior Data Scientist in the credit decisioning team of a consumer lender for four years, model owner of record for the two application scorecards, both of which passed independent validation in 2023 and 2025 with my signature on the model documentation.

professionalSummary.text: Holds an MSc in Statistics (2017) and BSc in Mathematics (2016), meeting the required educational qualification.

experienceHighlights.text: Supervised two data scientists on scorecard rebuilds, reviewing feature work and test plans prior to validation submissions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Supervised the two data scientists on the scorecard rebuilds, reviewing their feature work and the rebuild test plans before each validation submission.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented both scorecards to the credit risk committee at approval and annual review, with committee minutes documenting the presentations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented both scorecards to the credit risk committee at approval and at the annual review, with the committee minutes recording the presentations.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented model limitations and monitoring boundaries in scorecard documentation, updated after each annual review.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the model limitation section and the monitoring boundary section of each scorecard's documentation, updated after each annual review.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes signed model documentation with validation sign-off, committee minutes for approval, and degree certificate, providing verification trail via model inventory identifiers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the signed model documentation for one scorecard with the validation sign-off page, the committee minutes extract for its approval and the degree certificate, with the model inventory identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Model ownership, validation documentation, committee presentation, and model limitation documentation for credit decisioning scorecards.
skills.witness: Senior Data Scientist in the credit decisioning team of a consumer lender for four years, model owner of record for the two application scorecards, both of which passed independent validation in 2023 and 2025 with my signature on the model documentation. Presented both scorecards to the credit risk committee at approval and at the annual review, with the committee minutes recording the presentations. Wrote the model limitation section and the monitoring boundary section of each scorecard's documentation, updated after each annual review.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's educational qualification, model ownership, validation sign-off, supervision of data scientists, committee presentations, and documentation of limitations and monitoring boundaries. The materials do not establish the candidate's direct reporting line to the head of credit decisioning or specific interactions with model validation and the credit risk committee secretariat.
